name: dsh-tool-exposure
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: role-scoped tool exposure for agent presets — a Settings page that raises or lowers which tools registered by third-party plugins each role can see, applied through ctx.tools.restrict when the agent is created (snapshot semantics). DSH 插件：按角色（agent preset）管理第三方插件注册工具的暴露面，提供「角色 × 工具组」矩阵页，经 ctx.tools.restrict 在 agent 创建时生效（快照语义，配置保存只影响新建会话）。
author: keyblues
